agents.name: Destructive Operation Boundary
agents.summary: No destructive operations or security issues were found in the Ansible roles.

agents.name: Privilege Escalation Gate
agents.summary: The analysis identified a critical security issue in the Nginx Ansible role where tasks requiring root privileges are executed without explicitly declaring privilege escalation with `become: yes`. This creates an implicit dependency that is not documented, making the role less portable and potentially causing unexpected failures in production environments.
